name: The Mall at The Source
summary: The Mall at The Source is a regional shopping center located in Westbury, New York, offering convenient access to retail stores, dining, and services. With extended daily hours and a central Long Island location, it serves as a reliable shopping destination for Nassau County residents.
demographics: The Mall at The Source serves a diverse middle-income demographic in the Westbury area of Long Island, attracting families and working professionals from Nassau County. The trade area includes suburban households with median incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000, with a strong representation of both young families and established empty-nesters. Primary shoppers are value-conscious consumers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and dining options, with a mix of weekday lunch traffic from nearby office parks and weekend family shopping trips.
description: The Mall at The Source stands as a prominent shopping destination in Westbury, New York, strategically located at 1504 Old Country Road in the heart of Nassau County. This regional mall serves the Long Island community with convenient access to a diverse array of retail stores, dining establishments, and services. Operating daily from 8:30 AM to 10:00 PM, the center provides extended hours to accommodate busy shoppers throughout the week. With a solid 3.8-star rating from over 1,500 customer reviews, The Mall at The Source has established itself as a reliable shopping venue for local residents and visitors alike. The mall's central Long Island location makes it easily accessible from surrounding communities, offering a comprehensive retail experience for families, professionals, and shoppers seeking both everyday necessities and specialty items.
